verdict.rationale: Feature flags with user-property, cohort, and percentage targeting are a fair axis for an analytics product, since product-analytics platforms can ship flag rollouts. The evidence pack documents only reporting, admin, collection, and BigQuery export APIs for GA4. Nothing shows flag creation, targeting, or percentage rollouts. A community mention of Optimize refers to a separate product used for campaigns and is not GA4 feature-flag capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll out features behind flags targeted by user properties, cohorts, and percentage rollouts
